sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा सुमहत्कर्म रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वा दानवाश्चारणैः सह ।। ६.१०३.२७ ।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā sumahatkarma rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।viṣedurdevagandharvā dānavāścāraṇaiḥ saha ।। 6.103.27 ।।

translations.english: Those shafts of Rama in the form of eagles which could change their form at will, destroyed the serpent forms and they flew at great speed.
